Mallory J. Feldman, PhD

I am a postdoctoral scholar in Psychology and Neuroscience at The Ohio State University and a member of both the Affective Science Lab and the Social Neuroscience and Health Lab. I study how people sense and make sense of their bodies with implications for human health and social functioning across the lifespan.
